# CRL scope-enforcement test vectors (RFC 5280 5.2.5 issuingDistributionPoint / 6.3.3 CRL processing).
# EC P-256 ca_cert (anchor, CA:TRUE, keyCertSign+cRLSign, serial 1) -> leaf_cert (serial 0x1234,
# SAN=localhost, EKU serverAuth, crlDistributionPoints fullName URI:http://crl.tlslib.test/shard1.crl).
# Validity 2020-01-01..2099-12-31. Every CRL is signed by ca_key, thisUpdate 2020-01-01,
# nextUpdate 2099-12-31, carries a non-critical crlNumber, and revoked entries use revocation
# date 2020-06-01. IDP = issuingDistributionPoint; all IDPs are CRITICAL.
#   crl_shard1_revoked   - IDP fullName URI:http://crl.tlslib.test/shard1.crl (== leaf CDP); revokes 0x1234, reason keyCompromise(1)
#   crl_shard1_clean     - same IDP; no revoked entries
#   crl_shard2_clean     - IDP fullName URI:http://crl.tlslib.test/shard2.crl (!= leaf CDP); empty. Valid signature, wrong scope.
#   crl_noidp_clean      - no IDP; empty (authoritative for the leaf)
#   crl_noidp_revoked    - no IDP; revokes 0x1234, reason keyCompromise(1)
#   crl_onlyca           - IDP onlyContainsCACerts=TRUE (no DP name); empty
#   crl_onlyuser         - IDP fullName shard1 + onlyContainsUserCerts=TRUE; empty
#   crl_somereasons      - IDP fullName shard1 + onlySomeReasons={keyCompromise}; empty
#   crl_indirect         - IDP fullName shard1 + indirectCRL=TRUE; empty
#   crl_unknown_critical - no IDP; unrecognized CRITICAL extension OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.99999.1 value NULL (0500); empty
#   crl_delta            - no IDP; critical deltaCRLIndicator (2.5.29.27) = INTEGER 5; empty
#   crl_relative_dp      - IDP distributionPoint = nameRelativeToCRLIssuer RDN {CN=shard1} (no fullName); empty
#   crl_removefromcrl    - no IDP; revokes 0x1234, entry reason removeFromCRL(8)
#   crl_hold             - no IDP; revokes 0x1234, entry reason certificateHold(6)
# Generated with OpenSSL 4.0.1 (NB=20200101000000Z, NA=20991231000000Z; MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'):
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out ca.key
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key ca.key -sha256 -subj "/CN=TlsLib CRL Scope CA" -set_serial 1 -not_before NB -not_after NA
#     -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" -addext "subjectKeyIdentifier=hash" -out ca.pem
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out leaf.key
#   openssl req -new -key leaf.key -subj "/CN=localhost" -out leaf.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr -CA ca.pem -CAkey ca.key -set_serial 0x1234 -sha256 -not_before NB -not_after NA -extfile leaf.ext -out leaf.pem
#     leaf.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth /
#               subjectAltName=DNS:localhost / crlDistributionPoints=URI:http://crl.tlslib.test/shard1.crl /
#               subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   ca.cnf: [ca] default_ca=tlslib_ca / [tlslib_ca] database=$ENV::IDX certificate=ca.pem private_key=ca.key
#           crlnumber=crlnumber.txt (seeded 01) default_md=sha256 default_crl_days=29200 policy=pol_any / [pol_any] commonName=optional
#     [idp_shard1]      issuingDistributionPoint=critical,@idp_shard1_dp      / [idp_shard1_dp]      fullname=URI:http://crl.tlslib.test/shard1.crl
#     [idp_shard2]      issuingDistributionPoint=critical,@idp_shard2_dp      / [idp_shard2_dp]      fullname=URI:http://crl.tlslib.test/shard2.crl
#     [idp_onlyca]      issuingDistributionPoint=critical,@idp_onlyca_dp      / [idp_onlyca_dp]      onlyCA=TRUE
#     [idp_onlyuser]    issuingDistributionPoint=critical,@idp_onlyuser_dp    / [idp_onlyuser_dp]    fullname=URI:http://crl.tlslib.test/shard1.crl + onlyuser=TRUE
#     [idp_somereasons] issuingDistributionPoint=critical,@idp_somereasons_dp / [idp_somereasons_dp] fullname=URI:http://crl.tlslib.test/shard1.crl + onlysomereasons=keyCompromise
#     [idp_indirect]    issuingDistributionPoint=critical,@idp_indirect_dp    / [idp_indirect_dp]    fullname=URI:http://crl.tlslib.test/shard1.crl + indirectCRL=TRUE
#     [unknown_critical] 1.3.6.1.4.1.99999.1=critical,ASN1:NULL
#     [delta]            2.5.29.27=critical,ASN1:INTEGER:5   (the named "deltaCRL" extension has no config setter in OpenSSL; generic OID syntax used)
#     [idp_relative]    issuingDistributionPoint=critical,@idp_relative_dp    / [idp_relative_dp]    relativename=idp_relative_rdn / [idp_relative_rdn] CN=shard1
#   index files (openssl ca database): index_empty.txt is empty; revoked ones hold the row `openssl ca -revoke leaf.pem -crl_reason R` writes,
#     with the date pinned:  printf 'R\t20991231000000Z\t200601000000Z,<R>\t1234\tunknown\t/CN=localhost\n'   <R> = keyCompromise | removeFromCRL | certificateHold
#   IDX=<index> openssl ca -config ca.cnf -gencrl -crl_lastupdate NB -crl_nextupdate NA [-crlexts <section>] -out crl_X.pem
#     crl_shard1_revoked: index_keyCompromise + idp_shard1      crl_shard1_clean: index_empty + idp_shard1      crl_shard2_clean: index_empty + idp_shard2
#     crl_noidp_clean:    index_empty (no -crlexts)             crl_noidp_revoked: index_keyCompromise (no -crlexts)
#     crl_onlyca:         index_empty + idp_onlyca              crl_onlyuser:     index_empty + idp_onlyuser    crl_somereasons:  index_empty + idp_somereasons
#     crl_indirect:       index_empty + idp_indirect            crl_unknown_critical: index_empty + unknown_critical   crl_delta: index_empty + delta
#     crl_relative_dp:    index_empty + idp_relative            crl_removefromcrl: index_removeFromCRL (no -crlexts)   crl_hold: index_certificateHold (no -crlexts)
#   openssl crl -in crl_X.pem -CAfile ca.pem -noout   (verify OK for every CRL);  openssl crl -in crl_X.pem -text -noout / openssl asn1parse (extension checks)
#   openssl x509 -in X.pem -outform DER | xxd -p   (each *_cert field)
#   openssl pkey -in X.key -outform DER | xxd -p   (PKCS#8 DER, each *_key field)
#   openssl crl -in crl_X.pem -outform DER | xxd -p (each crl_* field)
